narration.full_text: Namaste, students! In this section, we'll embark on an exciting journey into the world of linear equations. We'll explore how to define pairs of linear equations in two variables and understand their general form. You'll also learn the graphical method for solving these equations, interpreting different types of solutions. Finally, we'll dive into the substitution method, a powerful algebraic technique to solve pairs of linear equations. Let's begin!
